leaderboard.title: Season leaderboard
leaderboard.lede: Points from every game played so far this season.
leaderboard.failed: The leaderboard couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
leaderboard.noGames: No game has been played this season yet.

matches.title: Matches
matches.failed: The matches couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
matches.none: No match is planned for this season yet.

match.missing: This season has no match with this number.

notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or the organisation behind it is no longer available. Check the address, or start from the home page.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.suspendedBody: The platform admin suspended {{org}}, so its pages are hidden for now. Nothing is deleted: when it's reactivated, everything comes back. Questions? Write to tournament-leaderboard@irmahs.dev.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.why: Admins sign in to enter scores and run their organisation. Players sign in to follow their own stats.
signIn.privacy: We only receive your name, email address and profile picture from Google. No password is stored here.
signIn.failed: Signing in didn't work. Try again, with a Google account whose email address is verified.
signIn.noOrganisations: You don't belong to any organisation yet.
signIn.separate: Each organisation keeps its own players, scores and admins. Being an admin in one gives you no access to another.

adminPlayers.title: Players
adminPlayers.lede: Players can be added and edited but never deleted, so past results stay intact. Changing a Riot ID keeps the old one as an alias.
adminPlayers.taken: Another player already has this Riot ID.
adminPlayers.invalid: Check the details: a player needs a Riot ID, and names have at most 100 characters.
adminPlayers.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
adminPlayers.emailHelp: The first person to sign in with this Google email gets this profile, with no claim. Only admins see it.
adminPlayers.linkedNote: Linked to an account: the player changes their Riot ID and Discord on My account.

adminScores.title: Enter scores
adminScores.lede: One game at a time. The leaderboard updates when you save.
adminScores.automaticLabel: {{bonus}}, {{name}}: worked out when you check or save
adminScores.carried: Players carried over from match {{match}}, game {{game}}: only the numbers need entering.
adminScores.bonusHelp: Automatic bonuses are worked out when you check them or save; manual ones are ticked by hand.
adminScores.clearAsk: Remove this game’s scores? The match stays, with its date.
adminScores.discard: Leave this game? Its unsaved changes will be lost.
adminScores.saved: Game {{game}} of match {{match}} saved. The leaderboard is up to date.
adminScores.checked: Bonuses checked. They are kept when you save.
adminScores.empty: Pick at least one player before saving.
adminScores.twice: Line {{row}}: this player is already on another line.
adminScores.refused: The scores were refused: check every number, then save again.
adminScores.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
adminScores.notWhole: Line {{row}}: {{stat}} is a whole number, such as 3.
adminScores.riotIdShape: Line {{row}}: a new player's Riot ID is Name#TAG, such as Kestrel#EUW.

adminSeasons.title: Seasons
adminSeasons.lede: Each season keeps its own scoring rules, so old results never change.
adminSeasons.name: Name
adminSeasons.tooSmall: Saved games don’t fit: the season already has a later match, or a match with more games.
adminSeasons.invalid: Check the details, then try again.
adminSeasons.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

problems.name: A season needs a name of at most {{maxName}} characters.
problems.games: A match has 1 to {{maxGames}} games, the fewest no more than the most.
problems.dates: A season can’t end before it starts.

adminSeasons.savedForNext: The rules saved for the next season

adminScoring.title: Scoring rules
adminScoring.lede: What each stat, each game’s KDA, a win and each bonus are worth in this season. A change applies to every game of the season at once; other seasons never change.
adminScoring.locked: {{season}} is finished, so its rules can’t change. Reopen it on the Seasons screen to change them.
adminScoring.statsHelp: A stat that’s switched off isn’t asked for on the Scores form, and stops counting in every game of the season, even games saved before. Switch Honours on to enter them.
adminScoring.shownOnly: Shown in tables, not added to points
adminScoring.placeOnly: Picks MVP and SVP, not added to points
adminScoring.kdaHelp: Each game’s (kills + assists) ÷ deaths, counting no deaths as one, times this.
adminScoring.bonusesHelp: Bonuses are worked out when a game is saved, and again for the whole season when the rules change. Players tied for the best value all win.

won.TOP_WINNER: Best place on the winning team
won.TOP_LOSER: Best place on the losing team

adminScoring.saved: {{season}}’s rules are saved, and its points follow them.
adminScoring.defaultsConfirm: Replace {{season}}’s rules with the platform defaults? Its other bonuses stay, and its points are worked out again.

problems.stat: {{stat}}: points go from -{{maxPoints}} to {{maxPoints}}, with up to two decimals.
problems.kda: The KDA points go from 0 to {{maxPoints}}, with up to two decimals.
problems.win: The points per win are a whole number from 0 to {{maxPoints}}.
problems.bonus: {{code}}: points are a whole number from 0 to {{maxPoints}}.

adminScoring.invalid: These rules were refused. Check the numbers and try again.
adminScoring.finished: This season is finished: reopen it to change its rules.
adminScoring.failed: That didn’t work. Try again in a moment.
adminScoring.removeConfirm: Remove {{code}} from {{season}}? It's taken off every game of the season, and the points follow.
adminScoring.bonusRemoved: {{code}} is removed, and the season's points follow.
adminScoring.saveFirst: Save or undo your changes above first.
adminScoring.bonusAdded: {{label}} is added, and the season's saved games are worked out again.

newBonusProblems.label: Give the bonus a name of {{max}} characters at most.
newBonusProblems.stat: Choose the stat the bonus compares.
newBonusProblems.threshold: The value to reach goes from 0 to {{maxThreshold}}.
newBonusProblems.points: A bonus's points are a whole number from 0 to {{maxPoints}}.

adminScoring.formulaHelp: How a game's points add up with the rules as typed above, before you save them.
adminScoring.savedForNext: The rules are kept for the next season; {{season}} doesn’t change.
adminScoring.nextSaved: Rules are saved for the next season. They’re offered first when you start it on the Seasons screen.
adminScoring.nextDiscarded: The rules saved for the next season are discarded.

adminMembers.title: Members
adminMembers.lede: Everyone who joined {{org}}. Admins enter scores and run the organisation.
adminMembers.inviteHelp: Admins are invited one by one, with the email of their Google account. The invite only works for that account, once.
adminMembers.badEmail: Type the email of their Google account.
adminMembers.pasteHelp: Paste it in WhatsApp, Discord or a text message. The code is shown only now: lost it? Revoke the invite and make a new one.
adminMembers.message: {{inviter}} invited you to help run {{org}} as an admin on Tournament Leaderboard. Sign in with the Google account for {{email}}: {{link}} (code {{code}}). Valid until {{date}}, and only once.
adminMembers.revoked: The invite for {{email}} no longer works.
adminMembers.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the organisation? Their player and scores stay.
adminMembers.ownershipHelp: The owner can hand ownership to another admin, and stays an admin. There's always exactly one owner, who can't be removed or made a player.
adminMembers.transferConfirm: Make {{name}} the owner? You stay an admin.
adminMembers.noOtherAdmin: Invite another admin first: ownership can only go to an admin.
adminMembers.ownerOnly: Only the owner can hand ownership on.
adminMembers.invalid: That was refused. Check the email and try again.
adminMembers.conflict: That isn't possible: they may already be an admin, or be the owner.
adminMembers.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

join.typeHelp: An admin sent you a code like K7QM-4FXP. Type it to see the invitation.
join.unknownBody: Check it was typed exactly as sent, or ask the admin for a new one.
join.tooManyBody: Wait a minute, then try again.
join.invited: {{inviter}} invited {{email}} to help run {{org}}. Sign in with the Google account for that address to accept.
join.wrongAccount: This invite is for {{email}}, and you’re signed in as {{me}}. Sign in with the invited Google account, or ask for an invite for this one.
join.failed: That didn’t work. The invite may have just expired or been used.
join.acceptedBody: You can now enter scores, manage players, seasons, scoring and members.
join.expiredBody: It was only valid for the time its admin chose. Ask an admin of {{org}} for a new one.
join.usedBody: An invite works only once. Ask an admin of {{org}} for a new one.
join.revokedBody: An admin of {{org}} stopped it. Ask them for a new one.
join.separate: Each organisation keeps its own players, scores and admins. Being an admin here gives you no access to any other organisation.

adminBranding.title: Branding and organisation
adminBranding.lede: How {{org}} looks to players: its names, language, logo, colour and links.
adminBranding.name: Name
adminBranding.descriptionHelp: One line, shown on the home page when your organisation is featured.
adminBranding.addressHelp: It can't be changed yet, so links already shared keep working.
adminBranding.logoHelp: A square PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image of 256 KB at most. Shown in the header of every page.
adminBranding.asText: Your colour as text on cards
adminBranding.accentHelp: When your colour is too light or too dark for small text, the site adjusts its shade for text only. Buttons and highlights keep your exact colour.
adminBranding.matchesHelp: Every new match starts with this many places.
adminBranding.socialHelp: Shown in the footer of every {{org}} page. Leave a field empty to hide it.
adminBranding.logoTooLarge: That image is larger than 256 KB.
adminBranding.logoType: A logo is a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image, without scripts.
adminBranding.invalid: Something in the form isn't allowed. Check each field and try again.

problem.name: Give the organisation a name of 60 characters at most.
problem.accent: The accent colour is a code such as #2F5BFF, or empty for the red.

link.discord: The Discord link must be an https:// address on Discord.
link.instagram: The Instagram link must be an https:// address on Instagram.
link.twitch: The Twitch link must be an https:// address on Twitch.
link.youtube: The YouTube link must be an https:// address on YouTube.
link.tiktok: The TikTok link must be an https:// address on TikTok.
link.website: The Website link must be an https:// address.

home.title: Run your seasons. Your colours, your rules.
home.lede: Leaderboards, match stats and scoring for seasonal Valorant tournaments. Pick the stats you track, set what every bonus is worth, and put your logo on it.
home.name: Organisation name
home.googleHelp: You'll sign in with Google to create it. We only receive your name, email address and profile picture, and no password is stored here.
home.owner: You'll be its owner and first admin. You can invite more admins from its Members page.

brand.title: Your brand
brand.text: Upload your logo and pick your accent colour. Buttons, highlights and the podium follow it, and text stays readable whatever you choose.

scoring.title: Your scoring
scoring.text: Choose which stats to record and how many points each one is worth, the bonuses and the points per win.

data.title: Your data only
data.text: Players, admins and results belong to one organisation. Nobody from another organisation can see or edit them.

create.title: Create your organisation
create.text: Name it, choose its address and invite the admins who will enter scores.

scoring.title: Set your scoring
scoring.text: Pick the stats, the bonuses and the points per win. Change them before each season.

scores.title: Enter scores after each game
scores.text: Type them in after each game. The leaderboard updates straight away.

problem.name: Give your organisation a name of 60 characters at most.
problem.slug: The address is 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, without a hyphen at either end.
problem.reserved: That address is kept for the platform. Choose another one.
problem.taken: That address is already taken. Choose another one.
problem.limit: One account can own 3 organisations at most.

platform.title: Organisations
platform.lede: Every organisation on Tournament Leaderboard. Only the one with the most recent saved game appears on the home page.
platform.suspendConfirm: Suspend {{name}}? Its pages and admin area will answer Not found until you reactivate it. Nothing is deleted.
platform.loadFailed: The organisations couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
platform.help: Suspending hides an organisation's pages and its admin area, and takes it off the home page. Nothing is deleted; reactivating brings everything back.

account.title: My account
account.lede: Your sign-in and the organisations you belong to.
account.google: Signed in with Google. We only receive your name, email address and profile picture; change them in your Google account.
account.ownerNote: You own this organisation. Hand ownership to another admin before leaving it.
account.leaveConfirm: Leave {{name}}? You'll lose access to it. Your results there stay.
account.deleteHelp: Removes your sign-in and your memberships. Player records and results stay with their organisations, unlinked. This can't be undone.
account.ownerConflict: You can't delete your account while you own an organisation. Hand ownership to another admin first, from its Members page.
account.identityHelp: Shown on your player profile in every organisation you play in. Claiming a profile gives it these too.
account.identitySaved: Your Riot ID and Discord are saved everywhere.
account.identityInvalid: Check your Riot ID, then try again.
account.identityTaken: Another player in one of your organisations already has this Riot ID.
account.suspendedNote: Suspended by the platform admin: its pages are hidden until it's reactivated.

players.title: Players
players.lede: Everyone playing this season, with their rank and season averages.
players.none: Nobody has played this season yet.
players.failed: The players couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
players.claimLink: Is one of them you? Claim your profile
players.riotIdShape: A Riot ID is a name of 3 to 16 characters, # and a tag of 3 to 5 letters or numbers, such as Kestrel#EUW.

player.failed: This player couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.

claim.title: Claim your profile
claim.lede: Link your account to the player record the admins already enter scores for. Your stats stay exactly where they are.
claim.joinHelp: Join as a player first. Joining on its own gives access to nothing; your profile link does, once an admin accepts it.
claim.joined: You joined as a player. Now pick your profile.
claim.linkedHelp: An admin accepted your claim: your account is linked to this player.
claim.linkedSelf: You're the only admin, so you approved your own claim: the link is marked self-approved.
claim.waitingHelp: An admin of {{org}} will accept or decline it. You'll see the answer here. Your stats don't move either way.
claim.search: Search the players nobody has claimed
claim.noneLeft: No player is left to claim.
claim.notListed: Not in the list? If you've never played here, create your profile below. If someone else linked your profile, ask an admin.
claim.adminsSee: An admin of {{org}} will see your Google name and email next to this profile, and decide.
claim.noteHint: For example: I play Jett in the Friday group
claim.conflict: That profile or claim changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
claim.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
claim.createHelp: Create your player profile now, with no admin needed. Admins can still rename it, or merge it with another one if you had played after all.
claim.createAs: It takes the Riot ID on your account: {{riotId}}.
claim.created: Your profile is created. Now sign up for a season.
claim.riotIdNeeded: Type your Riot ID, such as Name#TAG.

adminClaims.title: Claims
adminClaims.lede: Players asking to be linked to a profile. Accepting links their account; their stats stay where they are.
adminClaims.ownRule: Nobody approves their own claim while another admin exists. An organisation's only admin, its owner, can approve their own, and the link is marked self-approved.
adminClaims.reasonHint: For example: Kestrel is someone else's profile
adminClaims.ownClaim: Another admin accepts your own claim.
adminClaims.conflict: This claim was already answered, or the player is already linked. The list is up to date now.
adminClaims.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

mine.taken: That Riot ID is already a player here.
mine.invalid: Check your Riot ID and aliases, then try again.
mine.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
mine.renameNote: A new Riot ID keeps the old one as an alias.
mine.identityNote: Your Riot ID and Discord are the same in every organisation:

mySeasons.title: My seasons
mySeasons.lede: Sign up for a season to hear about its matches. There's no limit on how many sign up.
mySeasons.notMemberHelp: Join as a player and claim or create your profile first.
mySeasons.noProfile: You need a player profile first
mySeasons.noProfileHelp: Claim the profile admins already enter your scores for, or create one if you've never played.
mySeasons.none: No season is under way right now.
mySeasons.inHelp: You're signed up: you'll see each of its matches here once they're planned.
mySeasons.closed: Sign-ups are closed. An admin can still sign you up.
mySeasons.conflict: That changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
mySeasons.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
mySeasons.locked: The roster is locked: ask an admin to change your answer.

answered.WAITING: Match {{number}} is full: you're #{{position}} on the waiting list.
answered.DECLINED: Got it: you can't make match {{number}}.

adminSignUps.title: {{name}} sign-ups
adminSignUps.lede: Players sign up themselves while sign-ups are open, with no limit. You can sign anyone up at any time, players without an account too.
adminSignUps.over: This season is over: its sign-ups can't change.
adminSignUps.addHelp: For players without an account, or after sign-ups close. Players without an account can't answer themselves, so you'll confirm their matches on the roster.
adminSignUps.noMatch: No player left to sign up matches this.
adminSignUps.removed: {{name}} was withdrawn. They stop hearing about this season's matches.
adminSignUps.conflict: That changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
adminSignUps.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

adminSchedule.title: Schedule
adminSchedule.lede: Plan each match of the season: when and where it's played, the reply-by date and how many places it has. Players signed up for the season answer in the app.
adminSchedule.whereHint: A venue address or a Discord channel
adminSchedule.over: {{season}} is over: its schedule can't change.
adminSchedule.invalid: Check the details, then try again.
adminSchedule.conflict: More players are confirmed than that: move some to the waiting list first.
adminSchedule.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

problems.location: Where it's played has at most 200 characters.
problems.replyBy: The reply-by date comes before the match.

adminRoster.title: Match {{number}} roster · {{season}}
adminRoster.calledOff: This match is called off: answers can't change until it's back on.
adminRoster.played: This match was played: its scores are on the Scores page.
adminRoster.lockHelp: A locked roster is frozen, for example on match day: players can't change their answer. You still can.

empty.declined: Nobody said they can't make it.

adminRoster.movedUp: Moved up from the waiting list
adminRoster.addHelp: Any player of the organisation, players without an account too: they can't answer themselves, so you answer for them.
adminRoster.noMatch: No player left to write down matches this.
adminRoster.invalid: Check the number of places, then try again.
adminRoster.conflict: The match is full or called off: add a place, or move someone first.
adminRoster.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
adminRoster.autoHelp: When a place frees up, the first player waiting takes it. Turn it off to decide by hand.
adminRoster.remindHelp: Sends a notice to each player with an account who hasn't answered. Players are also reminded two days before the reply-by date.

notices.title: Notices
notices.lede: News from your organisations: matches planned, moved or called off, places freed up, claims, and what other admins changed.

kinds.MATCH_PLANNED: Match {{match}} of {{season}} is planned: {{when}}. Say whether you can make it.
kinds.REMINDER: You haven't said yet if you can make match {{match}} of {{season}} ({{when}}).
kinds.MOVED_UP: A place freed up: you're now confirmed for match {{match}} of {{season}} ({{when}}).
kinds.CLAIM_ACCEPTED: Your claim to {{riotId}} was accepted: its results are now yours.
kinds.ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED: Your organisation was suspended by the platform: its pages are hidden for now.
kinds.ORGANIZATION_REACTIVATED: Your organisation is active again: its pages are back.
